author: cocopopsonfire
quote:
I've always loved the original ocarina of time, but playing the original in 2026 is definitely not as fun as before and if released today with the same controls it would not hit the 10/10 I would have given it back when it launched

Thankfully when remaking the game they updated the controls and how it felt to play, removing basically every issue I had about playing the absolute masterpiece that is OoT. 

This is easily one of the best games on switch 2 and if it wasn't for Donkey Kong it would be the best by a country mile and even if you don't really play Zelda games it's 100% worth playing anyway
